# Shapes the cJSON renderer rejects with `panic("Invalid type")`: a
# property whose items are arrays but whose type is not itself an array
# or map (a nullable array of arrays, a nullable map of arrays).
input schema TopLevel {"type": "object", "properties": {"x": {"type": ["array", "null"], "items": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "integer"}}}}, "required": ["x"]}
pipeline {"lang": "cjson"}

render cjson {"filename": "TopLevel.h"}
